summary: Identified 6 distinct operating sponsors with qualifying Industrial acquisitions in Columbus between 2025-09-01 and 2026-08-31, each with a current CFO/Head of Acquisitions verified since 2026-03-01. Exclusions were due to portfolio totals, non-Industrial or out-of-market assets, brokers/managers, under-$5MM size, unverified or former contacts, duplicates, announced bids, and a record published after the cutoff.
limitations: For R9956, contact fields were updated by a current team-page update effective 2026-08-20; no separate contact_verified_at timestamp was provided for the new contact, so the update’s effective date evidences recency.
SPV-to-parent mapping was only explicitly evidenced for R2141; other possible corporate relationships were not provided.
One qualifying-looking deal (R1826) was excluded because the source was published after the 2026-08-31 cutoff.
Business emails are included only when published; where not published (e.g., R3919), email is reported as null.
